channel.title: Homeworld Press
channel.description: Independent editorial coverage of sci-fi literature, technology, space science, and tested buyer's guides.

item.title: Reader Letters Arrive Under a Headline Nobody Signed
item.description: The Guardian's books desk ran correspondence on November 13 under a promise about the end of everything. The sentence at the top was the paper's, and that is what the format is for.

item.title: Cold Water Will Not Explain Where Glacial Carbon Hid
item.description: Ice-age CO2 lows are usually taught as a story about cold water soaking up more gas. A sealed surface is the stronger candidate, and the argument between them is a measurement problem.

item.title: Smaller Plankton Means More Mouths Between a Cell and a Fish
item.description: The new ocean result points at cell size, not cell count. Chlorophyll can stay flat while the energy reaching a fish collapses.

item.title: A JBL Flagship Headphone Takes A Deep Black Friday Cut
item.description: The listing carries one real number and no test protocol, and that gap decides what a shopper can actually buy for a long flight.

item.title: Surveyor 6 Turned the Moon Into a Launch Pad in 1967
item.description: The anniversary entry gives a date, two verbs and a superlative, and the argument hides in what it leaves out.

item.title: NASA Prices Its Moon Base Ideas at a Million Dollars
item.description: Read the amount as a design constraint: at this price the prize buys documents and a list of who can think about lunar construction, and the rules decide whether either becomes hardware.

item.title: The Neuromancer Series Pitches the Story the Novel Left Out
item.description: The announcement leads with material the book refused to spend time on, and that choice settles the argument before a script exists.

item.title: Audible Recruits Its Own Reviews to Sell the Next Listen
item.description: The new audio discovery feature plays a sample, then a machine summary built from listener reactions, before you commit to a book.

item.title: A Hidden Pattern in Solar Magnetism Has to Outlive Its Instrument
item.description: The Parker Solar Probe result is best read as news about resolution and chosen statistics. A prediction the old description of the field could not make is what settles it.

item.title: A Fiery Birth Made Water the Young Mantle Had to Hold
item.description: The release states a production route. What is checkable in rock is how much of what Earth made stayed.
